title.narrative: Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora: Voluntary contribution

description.narrative: The Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES; at times also referred to as the Washington Convention) is a multilateral agreement that aims to ensure that international trade in animals and plants does not threaten their survival in the wild. It accords varying degrees of protection to more than 40,000 species. This payment by the Australian Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water is a one-off voluntary contribution to the CITES sponsored delegates project which supports delegates from developing countries to attend CITES Conference of the Parties
